# Java2D bicubic image transform, from oracle/java/Java2dBicubicProbe.java.
#
# Audiveris renders PDF pages through PDFBox with INTERPOLATION_BICUBIC and
# ANTIALIAS_OFF, so a native PDF ingest must reproduce this transform before
# any of its decoders are worth writing. The gray and binary rows are both
# recorded and are expected to agree: the source's own type does not change
# the result, which is one variable the port does not have to model.
#
